metrics.definition: Registered agent identities across the networks 8004scan indexes, observed 2026-10-11 (+1,012 in the prior 24 hours).
metrics.caveat: Registrations, not working agents: census work in the erc-8004 dossier finds a small minority expose a working endpoint. Explorer method not published.

metrics.definition: Feedback entries indexed by 8004scan, observed 2026-10-11 (+519 in 24 hours).
metrics.caveat: Includes Sybil feedback; counts are not reputation quality.

metrics.definition: Networks listed by 8004scan, observed 2026-10-11.
metrics.caveat: More than the 25 mainnets in the official contracts README; may include community deployments or testnets.

metrics.definition: Distinct wallet addresses seen by 8004scan, observed 2026-10-11.
metrics.caveat: Wallets are not people or operators.

metrics.metric: Adobe: growth in generative AI referral traffic to US retail sites, holiday 2025
metrics.definition: Visits to US retail sites from clicks in generative AI tools, 2025-11-01 to 2025-12-31, compared with the same period in 2024 (Adobe Analytics).
metrics.caveat: Measures traffic, not purchases or agent-executed payments; growth from a small base.

metrics.metric: Bain forecast: US agentic commerce by 2030
metrics.definition: US retail purchases that AI agents initiate, influence or complete by 2030, 15 to 25 percent of US online retail; simple AI-assisted search excluded.
metrics.caveat: Forecast, not an observation. Forecasts use different definitions and must not share an axis with observed volumes.

metrics.metric: Keyrock: on-chain transactions by AI agents
metrics.definition: Count of on-chain transactions Keyrock attributes to AI agents, May 2025 to April 2026.
metrics.caveat: Secondary report; includes x402 traffic that other analysts adjust for wash activity.

metrics.metric: Keyrock: on-chain value settled by AI agents
metrics.definition: On-chain payments that Keyrock attributes to AI agents from May 2025 to April 2026, nearly all in USDC.
metrics.caveat: Seed said the year to May 2026; ForkLog gives May 2025 to April 2026 and one French report gives April 2025 to May 2026. Report not read directly; attribution of transactions to agents is the author's method. asOf is the end of the reported window (month precision).

metrics.metric: McKinsey forecast: global revenue orchestrated by agents by 2030
metrics.definition: Global goods revenue orchestrated by AI agents by 2030; excludes services and B2B.
metrics.caveat: Forecast, not an observation. Forecasts use different definitions and must not share an axis with observed volumes. Month precision (October 2025).

metrics.metric: McKinsey forecast: US B2C revenue orchestrated by agents by 2030
metrics.definition: Revenue from US business-to-consumer goods purchases that AI agents orchestrate by 2030, under moderate merchant-readiness assumptions; goods only.
metrics.caveat: Forecast, not an observation. Forecasts use different definitions and must not share an axis with observed volumes. Month precision: McKinsey dates the report October 2025; the seed day 2025-10-17 was not confirmed. 'Orchestrated' is the broadest definition among the forecasts here.

metrics.metric: Morgan Stanley forecast: US agentic e-commerce by 2030, base case
metrics.definition: Agentic gross merchandise value in US e-commerce by 2030, base case (about 10 percent of US e-commerce).
metrics.caveat: Forecast, not an observation. Forecasts use different definitions and must not share an axis with observed volumes. Date is the first press report (2025-12-09); the seed date 2025-12-08 and the Morgan Stanley report were not reached directly.

metrics.metric: Morgan Stanley forecast: US agentic e-commerce by 2030, bull case
metrics.definition: Agentic gross merchandise value in US e-commerce by 2030, bull case (about 20 percent of US e-commerce).
metrics.caveat: Forecast, not an observation. Forecasts use different definitions and must not share an axis with observed volumes. Secondary reports only.

metrics.metric: Salesforce: online holiday sales influenced by AI and agents, 2025
metrics.definition: Global online sales from 2025-11-01 to 2025-12-31 that Salesforce attributes to AI and agents (recommendations, engagement and agents), out of $1.29 trillion total.
metrics.caveat: Influence attribution by a vendor, not agent-executed payments; global, not US-only.

metrics.definition: Distinct paying agents shown on mppscan, observed 2026-10-11.
metrics.caveat: Agents are payer addresses as the explorer defines them.

metrics.definition: Distinct paid servers shown on mppscan, observed 2026-10-11.
Transactions shown on the mppscan home page, observed 2026-10-11; the page query used a 7-day window.
metrics.caveat: Third-party explorer; window inferred from page data; method not published.

metrics.definition: Payment value shown on the mppscan home page, observed 2026-10-11.
metrics.caveat: Third-party explorer; covers MPP payments it can see on chain, not Stripe card charges through Shared Payment Tokens.

metrics.definition: Cumulative MPP payment value measured by Visa and Artemis, data to 2026-04-21, across about 115,000 transfers.
metrics.caveat: Secondary report of the Visa and Artemis study; about five weeks after MPP's public launch.

metrics.metric: Artemis 'Gamed Tx' share of x402 transactions
metrics.definition: Average share of x402 transactions Artemis flagged as gamed, 2025-11-09 to 2026-02-07; peak 90.21 percent.
metrics.caveat: Secondary analysis; detection logic unpublished.

metrics.definition: Distinct buyers shown on the x402.org counter; first archived with this value on 2025-12-14 and still shown on 2026-10-19.
metrics.caveat: Addresses, not people; same stale-counter caveat.

metrics.definition: Distinct sellers shown on the x402.org counter; first archived with this value on 2025-12-14 and still shown on 2026-10-19.
metrics.caveat: Same stale-counter caveat.

metrics.definition: Value shown on the x402.org home page counter; first archived with this value on 2025-12-14 and still shown on 2026-10-19.
metrics.caveat: Displayed value, not a live 30-day measurement: the page shows the same four values in every archived copy from 2025-12-14 and on 2026-10-19, with no date. Do not present as current activity.

metrics.definition: Value shown on the x402.org home page counter; first archived with this value on 2025-12-14 and still shown on 2026-10-19.
metrics.caveat: Same stale-counter caveat; raw volume includes activity that Artemis adjusts away.

metrics.metric: Visa and Artemis: adjusted x402 transactions
metrics.definition: Cumulative x402 transactions after Artemis adjustment, data to 2026-04-21; average about $0.14.
metrics.caveat: On 2026-07-16 The Defiant reported Visa's Cuy Sheffield citing about $19 million across about 134 million adjusted transactions, with no data date.

metrics.metric: Visa and Artemis: adjusted x402 volume
metrics.definition: Cumulative x402 payment value excluding identified wash and test activity (Artemis's proprietary method), from the May 2025 launch to 2026-04-21.
metrics.caveat: Raw cumulative total was over $135.7 million across 178.3 million transactions. Report published 2026-07-14, commissioned by Visa.
